# Verisign
> Global provider of domain name registry services and internet infrastructure, operating critical internet navigation and DNS services.

Verisign manages domain name registry services for major top-level domains and provides internet infrastructure resources, educational materials, security reporting, and corporate information for customers, partners, investors, and researchers.

## About Verisign
- [About Verisign](https://www.verisign.com/about-us/): Overview of Verisign’s role, business, and internet infrastructure mission.
- [Verisign History](https://www.verisign.com/about-us/verisign-history/): Timeline and background on Verisign’s corporate and internet infrastructure history.
- [Mission and Values](https://www.verisign.com/about-us/mission-values/): Statement of company mission, principles, and organizational values.
- [Leadership](https://www.verisign.com/about-us/leadership/): Profiles of Verisign’s executive leadership team.
- [Verisign Cares](https://www.verisign.com/about-us/verisign-cares/): Information about community engagement and corporate responsibility initiatives.
- [Careers](https://www.verisign.com/careers/): Employment opportunities, culture, and recruiting information.
- [Investor Relations](https://investor.verisign.com/investor-relations): Financial reports, governance materials, and investor updates.

## Registry and Internet Infrastructure
- [Verisign as a Domain Registry](https://www.verisign.com/what-we-do/verisign-registry/): Explains Verisign’s registry services and responsibilities for top-level domains.
- [Root Zone Maintainer](https://www.verisign.com/what-we-do/root-zone-maintainer/): Overview of Verisign’s role in maintaining the DNS root zone.
- [Regional Internet Resolution Service](https://www.verisign.com/what-we-do/regional-internet-resolution-service/): Details on regional DNS resolution service capabilities and operations.
- [Internet Governance](https://www.verisign.com/what-we-do/internet-governance/): Resources on internet governance topics and Verisign’s participation.
- [Domain Names](https://www.verisign.com/domain-names/): Information about domain names, registration concepts, and related resources.

## DNS and Internet Fundamentals
- [What Is DNSSEC?](https://www.verisign.com/what-we-do/what-is-dnssec/): Introductory explanation of DNSSEC and its role in DNS security.
- [What Is the DNS?](https://www.verisign.com/what-we-do/what-is-the-dns/): Overview of the domain name system and how it works.
- [What Is a URL?](https://www.verisign.com/what-we-do/what-is-a-url/): Basic explanation of URLs and their components.
- [Domain Names](https://www.verisign.com/domain-names/): Educational content about domain names and internet addressing.

## Support and Security
- [Support](https://www.verisign.com/support/): Customer and partner support resources and assistance entry point.
- [Report a Vulnerability](https://www.verisign.com/report-a-vulnerability/): Security vulnerability disclosure and reporting instructions.

- [About Us](https://www.verisign.com/about-us/): Main corporate information hub for company background and leadership.
